# MyTazki

> MyTazki is an AI-powered Islamic companion PWA for daily Muslim spiritual growth. Grow spiritually every day with guided Quran reflections, Azkar, Duas, and personalised Islamic journeys.

MyTazki helps Muslims build consistent spiritual habits through AI-guided Quran reflections, Azkar (remembrance) sessions, authentic Duas (supplications), accurate prayer times, and a personal Islamic growth journey. Powered by Claude AI with Islamic adab guidelines.

## Features

- AI Islamic Companion — Claude-powered 24/7 spiritual guidance with Islamic adab
- Guided Quran Reflections — all 114 surahs with Arabic, translation, and audio (Alafasy)
- Azkar & Dhikr Sessions — 35 audio-guided sessions across 7 emotional pathways
- Duas Library — 110+ authentic duas organised by occasion and need
- Prayer Times (Salah / Namaz) — accurate times based on GPS location
- Qibla Direction Compass — real-time qibla finder
- Masjid / Mosque Finder — nearby mosques with map and GPS
- Zakat Calculator — calculates zakat on gold, silver, savings, and assets
- Islamic Calendar — Hijri date, Islamic events, and moon phases
- 99 Names of Allah (Asma ul Husna) — with Arabic, meaning, and benefits
- Islamic Baby Names — 1000+ names with meanings and origins
- Tasbih Counter — digital dhikr bead counter
- Streak & Goal Tracker — daily salah and Quran streaks
- Islamic Growth Journal — personal reflection and gratitude log
- Push Notifications — prayer time reminders and daily Azkar alerts
- Qurbani, Wudu, Salah, Farz, and Sadqa guides

## Audience

Modern Muslims seeking a calm, premium digital Islamic lifestyle companion. Suitable for all ages and schools of thought (Sunni, Shia, General).

## Technology

- Progressive Web App (PWA) — works on iOS, Android, and desktop
- AI powered by Anthropic Claude via Replit AI Integrations
- Quran data from api.alquran.cloud; audio from everyayah.com (Alafasy recitation)
- Prayer times from aladhan.com; Hijri calendar from aladhan.com
- Mosque finder using Overpass API (OpenStreetMap)
